title.description: The topic being explained (e.g., 'Understanding Transparent Data Encryption', 'Oracle 19c Patching Lifecycle').

scenario.description: A real-world business or technical scenario.

why_it_fits.description: Why this concept/feature is the right choice for the scenario.

use_cases.description: When and why to use this feature.

concept_term.description: The specific feature, rule, or concept requested.

compliance_rules.description: Any strict rules, licensing constraints, or security implications to be aware of.

simple_definition.description: An ELI5 (Explain Like I'm 5) analogy or plain-english description.

url.description: A valid URL or Support ID.

doc_title.description: Title of the Oracle Doc or MOS Note.

technical_definition.description: The highly technical, deep-dive explanation of how it works under the hood.

visual_aid_suggested.description: Whether an infographic would help explain the concept.

image_generation_prompt.description: Detailed prompt for generating an educational infographic explaining the theory or mechanics of the concept.
